title: Background task notifications open their own ledger task rows titled <task-notification>
observation: Claude Code delivers a background-command completion as a UserPromptSubmit turn whose prompt starts with the notification tag. The prompt hook treats it as a user prompt: it opens a task, and with taskTitles: prompt the row is titled '<task-notification>'. With 1.38 continuation the row joins the episode, so it is not orphaned, but every background command completion still adds an empty task row and a hook-generated instruction to call hunch_task start with that title, which the 1.38 changelog said follow-up turns would no longer do. Observed 2026-09-16: htask_c248b8b1e7a0b0deaf18b9fd title '<task-notification>' continues htask_3f3062ed568d44c4ed1fee83.
